newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ispat increases size of IPO, ups price range.
newsitem.headline: Ispat increases size of IPO, ups price range.

text.p: Steel group Ispat International NV said on Tuesday it would increase the size of its initial public offering to 25 million shares from 19.25 million.
It also said the price range of the shares on offer would be raised to between $26 and $27 from $22 to $26.
The number of shares offered by the Ispat remains unchanged at 16 million, but the company's controlling shareholder, chairman Lakshmi Mittal, will now offer 9 million shares.
Additionally, he has granted underwriters an over-allotment option for 3.75 million shares, Ispat said in a statement.
Ispat said listing for the class A common shares had been approved for the Amsterdam and New York stock exchanges.
It said it expected trading to start simultaneously in New York and Amsterdam at 1330 GMT on the first business day after pricing.
Last month, joint global coordinator CSFB said the offering would be the largest IPO in the steel sector for at least 30 years.
Mittal said Ispat's market capitalisation would be roughly one and a half that of Dutch steel group Hoogovens, based on the (former) indicative share price of $22-$26.
